text:
ben: Heads up — the runtime docs TOC collapsed on staging after the sidebar tweak. On mobile the child pages disappear. https://internal.docs/redwood/runtime/ TOC shows only top-level. Anyone on owners for /runtime/#toc ?

docs-bot: auto-scan: 1 broken anchor found in /runtime/ - child anchors missing after #sidebar-update. scan-id: scan-2026-03-21-01

sara: @ben I can take a look later today. Is this blocking a customer demo?

ben: Not blocking demo yet, but visibility is bad and QA flagged it. Prefer a small fix + redirect for old anchors.

elaine: If it's CSS collapse on mobile probably a missing aria attribute in the new sidebar component. Quick test: open inspector -> see `.toc-collapsed` toggled. I can open a PR with fix + a changelog note.

alex: FYI we should probably add a tiny integration test to the docs CI to catch TOC regressions. I can add one after the PR.

sara: sounds good. Who should be the codeowner on the PR? @eng-docs or @eng-platform?

ben: let's request review from eng-docs (codeowners: @sara @elaine). @alex can do CI follow-up.

elaine: I'll push a branch `fix/toc-mobile-collapse` and link the PR here. Will add a short unit test for the component and a redirect mapping for the broken anchors.

docs-bot: deploy-bot: staging preview will be created once PR passes CI — reply with the PR number.

sara: thanks! @ben can you add the minimal repro steps in the PR description so QA can validate quickly?

ben: yep will paste steps and one screenshot. ETA EOD.

alex: created issue RWD-1343 to track CI test. assigning to me for follow-up.

elaine: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 — small CSS tweak + test + redirect table entry. PTAL @sara @ben :shipit:

sara: reviewing now.

ben: thumbs up once merged I'll do the QA pass on staging.
